split_policy: Semantic groups kept intact; exact canonical expected-plan signatures disjoint between splits. Similar vocabulary and task types intentionally shared; not a domain-generalization claim.
holdout_policy: Do not expose sealed questions or expectations to implementation until code freeze; once replayed after diagnosis report feedback-exposed regression.

assessment.sample: complete same-request execution scope and conditions required; no keyword-only or answer-only success
assessment.equivalence: both equivalent members must independently pass and canonical actual plans agree
assessment.contrast: contrast member must pass its distinct expected plan/hold and must not collapse to equivalent signature
assessment.group: all three case-level results plus equivalence and contrast pass
